roles.abertura: Opening pomp: the first impact of the video, never in the body.
roles.secao: Change of subject or chapter — structure, not ornament.
roles.destaque: The most important sentence of the region: revelation, turn, thesis.
roles.enfase: Highlight inside the speech: one strong word or passage.
roles.info: Factual data: date, number, value, name, place, bible reference — never opinion.
roles.conclusao: Closing of the video: final reflection, ending — never an opening.

rulesSummary.golden: The SPEECH anchors the reading point. A highlight enters preRoll before the first spoken word of its block (the animation impact lands exactly when the word is said), covers the WHOLE speech of the block, and breathes a tail into the silence up to the next speech. ONE highlight on screen at a time — neighbours never overlap. This holds for the local engine, for manual application and for anything the AI proposes: the intake recomputes start/end from these rules and rejects what cannot fit.
rulesSummary.anchor: The speech anchor of a highlight is the first spoken word OF ITS OWN TEXT, never the start of the block group: literal text is located in the word JSON (its first 2-3 words in sequence); authored/summary text must carry palavra or palavraIdx; a proposal whose text cannot be anchored inside a speech span longer than 2.5 s is rejected (texto autoral sem ancora na fala). The item appears at most preRoll (<= 0.5 s by class) before that word and keeps the tail rule after the speech ends.
rulesSummary.textReading: reading duration of a text = 0.9s + beats / 2.5 per second, clamped 1.6–6s (a beat = a content word; connectives of the detected language do not count)
rulesSummary.maxBeatsInWindow: floor((min(6, max(1.6, windowS)) − 0.9) × 2.5) — a text with more beats than this (+1 tolerance) is rejected; shorten it
hard: exclusivo: only when the block carries one of the style subtypes
info styles with declared subtypes: only the matching subtype
strict universe: never outside the active preset kit

highlights.blocoId: caption id of the speech block (required)
highlights.texto: optional authored text (default: the block speech). If it quotes the speech, its first 2-3 words are located in the word JSON and anchor the highlight; if it is a summary, palavra or palavraIdx is REQUIRED on spans longer than 2.5 s
highlights.campos: optional field values by field id (see highlights[id].texto.campos)
highlights.palavra: word of the block that anchors the highlight (the item appears at most preRoll before it is spoken) — required for authored/summary text
highlights.palavraIdx: optional 0-based index of the spoken word in the block
